day: Day 1: Travel from Delhi to Goa – Arrival & Beachside Relaxation
activities: Morning: Take a direct flight from Delhi to Goa.
Afternoon: Arrive and check in to your hotel/resort near Baga or Calangute Beach.
Evening: Relax by the beach, enjoy a sunset walk, and dine at a beach shack.

day: Day 2: North Goa – Forts, Churches & Nightlife
activities: Morning: Explore Aguada Fort and Chapora Fort for scenic views.
Afternoon: Visit the historic St. Alex Church in Calangute and relax at Anjuna Beach.
Evening: Experience Goa’s nightlife at Club Tito’s or Café Mambo.

day: Day 3: South Goa – Peaceful Beaches & Portuguese Vibes
activities: Morning: Head to South Goa and unwind at Palolem Beach.
Afternoon: Visit Cabo de Rama Fort and enjoy the silence of Butterfly Beach.
Evening: Sunset dinner at a beach café like Salcete Beach Shack or Martin's Corner.

day: Day 4: Old Goa & Spice Plantation Tour
activities: Morning: Visit Old Goa’s UNESCO churches – Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral.
Afternoon: Explore a spice plantation near Ponda with a traditional Goan lunch.
Evening: Return to hotel and relax or stroll through Fontainhas (Latin Quarter).

day: Day 5: Adventure Day – Water Sports & Dolphin Cruise
activities: Morning: Go parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat riding at Calangute or Candolim.
Afternoon: Enjoy a dolphin-watching cruise along the Arabian Sea.
Evening: Free time to explore local cafés or get a relaxing massage at the spa.
Morning: Take a boat tour to Grand Island for snorkeling or scuba diving.
Afternoon: Enjoy BBQ lunch on the island beach and swim in clear waters.
Evening: Attend a Goan folk dance show or beachside live music performance.
Morning: Shop for souvenirs at Anjuna Flea Market or Mapusa Market.
Afternoon: Check out from hotel and head to the airport.
Evening: Fly back to Delhi with unforgettable memories of Goa.
